title: ZC Smart Digital: Managed Virtual Assistant Service (explainer)
note: Rosa's Catering is a fictional sample business. Narration: ElevenLabs voice 'Mel - Warm & Conversational' (Filipino English accent), take 2, pauses tightened and sped up 6%. 'warp' maps video time to the original animation timeline so scenes follow the voice.

cues.text: It's a busy Saturday at Rosa's Catering.
Orders keep coming, and a new event inquiry slips by unanswered.
That's where a ZC Smart Digital virtual assistant steps in.
Managed, trained and ready for your business.
First, your inbox. Your VA sorts every message and flags new inquiries,
then drafts a friendly reply in your tone, so no customer waits.
Next, your calendar. Appointments get booked and confirmed,
with reminders sent, and no more back-and-forth.
And every Friday, a clear weekly report
shows your inquiries, bookings and response times.
Get your time back with a managed virtual assistant.
Book a free consultation at zcsmartdigital.com.
